name: Terraria Clicker [MULTIPLAYER & 💾]
desc:
A clicker game heavily inspired and based on the game Terraria made by Re-Logic.

🚨 Update: 💾 New File Saving System! 🚨

Welcome to Terraria Clicker!

⚔️ - Slay enemies and bosses to scavenge items!
🛠️ - Use items to craft powerful weapons or to upgrade your NPC!
✨ - Several Biomes with unique enemies to encounter!
